Checks.Name: Menu acknowledges the first burst at its exact boundary
Command index remains fixed while no further input is issued
Resume acknowledges without advancing a command
Second burst reaches the exact final command
Simulation and audio close without error
Actual queue pressure was exercised and stayed bounded
Every ordinary command survives the two bursts unchanged
All ordered audio packets are consumed and returned
Shutdown drains an actually pending queue through the exact final packet

Audio.Meaning: PowerShell runspace mixing and waveOut playback; packet age ends at submission, not audible output. Starvation is queue polling, not hardware telemetry. Reset/exit can cancel queued tail audio; cancelled frame count is an upper bound.

Meaning: Two unpaced 150-command bursts through the real simulation and audio device with menu/resume between them. DrainOnClose removes the artificial two-second tail sleep and requests actual bounded shutdown draining. No terminal renderer or live effect window. Bounded-queue/control regression, not a gameplay pacing or physical listening qualification.
